entries.007338eb0529f6e8: This is the sole reportable segment of the company group. In addition to manufacturing and selling building materials, including extrusion-molded cement products, the company undertakes contracting, design, and supervision of construction works using its products. Sales are handled by the company and consolidated subsidiary Nozawa Shōji Co., Ltd., and the latter supplies part of the auxiliary materials used by the company. The company and Nozawa Shōji Co., Ltd. also design and carry out construction works. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥22,312 million, of which revenue from extrusion-molded cement products was ¥17,492 million and other revenue was ¥4,820 million, by product and service.

entries.06f7fadd686a043b: The company has formulated the medium-term management plan "NOZAWA NEXT3" and will work in three categories: "KOKOROZASHI-Vision," "MINORI-Profit," and "ISHIZUE-Base." In "MINORI," it will enrich the product lineup of "Aslock," exterior wall material for general buildings, from low-price to high-price ranges, promote expanded sales of "Aslock factory-painted products" and adoption of "factory pre-processing," and, as a new business, develop "Milfia," an on-site painting method for multi-color finishing for Aslock, and develop the market as a painting work business of its subsidiary Nozawa Shoji Co., Ltd. In "ISHIZUE," it will work on promoting use of AI and DX, securing and developing human resources, and reforming the personnel system.
